text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Sakura Bakushin O and I
decide
to get some food before heading
back.
However...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! There's actually a place I wanna
take you
to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, I let Sakura Bakushin O take the
lead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to this! The inn's
premium
course is famous for its
all-you-can-eat crab
dishes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho, it looks like you've become all
fidgety
with excitement yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
He he he... don't worry! You're my VIP
today!
choice_data_list: いや、カード使えるかなって……
choice_data_list_en: No, I was just wondering if they took cards...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The other day I came across an elderly
lady
curled up in pain, and so I took her
to the
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It turns out she was the owner of this
place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As a thank-you, she invited me to visit
and said I
could bring someone
important along with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So don't worry! Just enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by Sakura Bakushin O's words, I
relax as I
wait for each dish to come out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hooo! It's SO good! Each dish tastes so
high-class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How is it? Delicious, right? Isn't the
flavor
life-changing?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Onto the main dish! Is what I
wanna say,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's one of those fancy crabs served up in
its
entirety! And... I'm not good at
opening up
seafood that's presented like
this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Like, the meat is totally inaccessible!
Hiding
inside that spiky shell! How
cowardly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...True, carefully taking the shell off the
crab is
troublesome work for a hasty girl
like her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perseverance! That makes sense!
Perseverance
helps overcome all
obstacles!
choice_data_list: 道具でサクッといける
choice_data_list_en: Crab is a test of patience!
Tools will make quick work of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Perseverance is a model student's
specialty!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnngg! Bakushin perseveeerance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SNAP! CRACK!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I somehow managed to break
open the
shell.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh! Yes, this is the perseverance of a model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! While you're eating, I'll
free another
crab from its shell!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I decided I want you to
thoroughly enjoy
yourself!
choice_data_list_en: I'm gonna do it myself, all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stirred by Sakura Bakushin O's offer, I
decide to
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The broken shards of crab shell do hurt
my
tongue, but eating together is a lot
of fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That meal was so good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My pleasure! It was thanks to your words
that I
was able to persevere and defeat
those crabs!
choice_data_list: 堪能させてくれて、ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for letting me enjoy it to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You always motivate me like that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you were one of my classmates, I
would scout
you to be the vice class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This is how you must've felt when
you scouted
me, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I see, I see! No need to get
bashful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The banquet leaves us with full stomachs
and full
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pass her a special spoon for eating
crab.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh? To think such a durable crab can
be
dismantled so easily!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Leave the de-shelling to me!
Please sit
back and enjoy the meat,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I decided I want you to
thoroughly enjoy
yourself!
choice_data_list_en: I'm gonna do it myself, all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stirred by Sakura Bakushin O's offer, I
decide to
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Munch, munch! Ah, the next crab has
arrived! And
what a bulky boy!
BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her moving swiftly and dexterously
to
dismantle the crabs, we wind up
consuming a
large amount of food, but
we do so happily...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That was some good food!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm the one who should be
thankful!
choice_data_list: 堪能させてくれて、ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for letting me enjoy it to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've gained another

Bakushin-related skill!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me lots of things from now
on! And...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As someone important to me, help make
my
Bakushin bigger and better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The banquet leaves us with full stomachs
and
refreshed spirits.
